calls.video_title: Should You Buy the Dip in Super Micro Stock? | SMCI Stock Analysis
calls.stance_flip: Parkevtate was AVOID on SMCI — he warned investors against buying all year, last updated 11 Aug — now BUY: 'the new situation warrants an upgrade... it looks like an attractive stock to buy for investors that have a higher risk tolerance.' First tracked SMCI call in calls.json (no prior tracked entry); flip is from his own stated prior stance in the video.
calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $56 (stated, updated); forward P/E 3.9 (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY — FLIP from AVOID: FY27 revenue guidance raised to a $77bn midpoint (+10% vs 3 months ago) with gross margin forecast ~12% (near the top of the decade range) and FCF estimates revised up, so the stock looks significantly undervalued even after a big risk premium for management history — for high-risk-tolerance investors only.
calls.base_case: FY27 revenue midpoint $77bn, gross margin ~12%; Wall Street expects ~23% EPS growth per year; $6.9bn cash and short-term investments cushions the cash-flow mismatch.
calls.bull_case: Forward P/E 3.9 is near the cheapest in years; DCF fair value $56 vs a much lower price; margins improving toward mid-teens.
calls.bear_case: Operating cash flow negative since 2022; over $7bn long-term debt; one customer ~50% of revenue; management transparency history (late filings, former auditor resigned citing lack of transparency); data-centre readiness delays can slow growth.
